title: Adaptive Favicon
description:
Simple web app that generates adaptive favicons that change with the user's system theme (light/dark mode).

Generate your own adaptive favicon and make your website more engaging.
why: To test how far AI-assisted "vibe coding" can take a small product from idea to production. Gave it to a couple of builders to see how they compare (V0, Firebase and Antigravity).
learned: Firebase (at the time) was the only one to create a functional website from basic prompt. SVG favicons can carry their own prefers-color-scheme media queries, and browser support for them is uneven, so you need a fallback.
